text.en: Label: can cause fetal harm. Dangerous in pregnancy.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Based on findings from animal studies and its mechanism of action, anastrozole tablets may cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.1) ] .

text.en: Label: breastfeeding not recommended, or choose between the drug and breastfeeding.

lactation.quote: … ole in animal studies, or the potential for serious adverse reactions in the breast-fed child from anastrozole tablets, advise lactating women not to breastfeed during treatment with anastrozole tablets and for 2 weeks after the last dose.

text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: Clinical studies in pediatric patients included a placebo-controlled trial in pubertal boys of adolescent age with gynecomastia and a single-arm trial in girls with McCune-Albright Syndrome and progressive precocious puberty.

text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: In studies 0030 and 0027, about 50% of patients were 65 or older.
